# Overview
High-level project grounding for review. Digest expands this from mission.md and architecture.md.
## Grounding
Gitboard serves as a local orchestration interface for developer workflows involving GitLab and GitHub. It maps the state of remote forge activities—including CI/CD status, open Merge Requests, and job failures—directly to the local developer's worktree and checkout state.
The system operates via a structured typology of local and remote entities, organized through the following core components:
Slice Objective Ledger: Defines the primary operational goals and state transitions for local repository synchronization and dashboard updates.
Refined Typology Catalog: Categorizes the various forge entities (Issues, MRs, Pipelines, Worktrees) and their corresponding local representations.
Agents interacting with Gitboard should focus on the ledger objectives to ensure local state remains synchronized with remote forge realities.
